description: Alpha Vantage global quote for one stock or ETF ticker: price, open/high/low, volume, previous close and change, from Alpha Vantage's free API. Needs a free Alpha Vantage API key (ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY); free keys are rate limited. Usually answers in about 9 s, up to 22 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
